title: 第9章 三世记忆觉醒打算提前进入养老生活第10章 新的力量
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
她看到了…第一次尝试用混沌之力为自己重塑身体，却因是首次，有所欠缺，新身体无法修炼灵力。
但她凭借混沌之力与冥界之力，依旧在那个低等位面掀起风云，并在席卷诸天的混沌之战中，为保护那个接纳了她的位面，以生命为代价，引动混沌本源，筑起庇护屏障，最终魂归冥界。
那一世，她得到了完整的混沌本源认可。
她看到了…重回冥界，以冥主之尊与混沌本源之力，再次精心重塑神躯，开启第三世。
这一世，她本只想平凡度过，不再背负真神与冥主的沉重责任，封印了绝大部分力量，只想体验简单的生活…所以，她选择了青云宗，成为了“云杳杳”
记忆如潮水般涌过，又缓缓平复。
那浩瀚无尽的岁月，那刻骨铭心的背叛，那冥界征伐的残酷，那守护位面的决绝…最终都沉淀下来，融入了此刻这具炼气五层的身体里，融入了那看似跳脱不羁的灵魂深处。
云杳杳…或者说，经历了三世轮回，身为九千神界唯一真神、冥界至高主宰、混沌本源掌控者的她，缓缓睁开了眼睛。
那双眸子里，曾经的清澈灵动依旧在，却更深邃了，仿佛蕴藏着无尽星空与亘古洪荒，一种难以言喻的淡漠与威严自然流露，却又被她巧妙地收敛，藏于眼底深处。
她低头，看了看自己的手，炼气五层的灵力微薄得可怜。
她又感知了一下识海深处那沉寂的、足以轻易覆灭整个修真界的恐怖力量，以及丹田深处那一缕被自我封印的、灰蒙蒙的混沌之气和冥界死气。
只要她愿意，一个念头，就能解开封印，重归那无上之境。
但她只是轻轻叹了口气，眼神复杂。
“原来如此…”
她低声自语，声音带着一丝几不可察的疲惫与释然，“第一世太累，第二世太苦，这一世…本想偷偷懒的。”
她想起这一世在青云宗的点点滴滴：问心阶上烤地脉薯，藏书阁里啃书吃零嘴，丹峰瞎炼极品丹，器峰定制鸳鸯锅，符峰乱画清风符，阵峰改进锁鲜阵…还有那三个紧张兮兮却愿意为她护法的小跟班，那个表面严肃却给她极大自由度的便宜师傅，那些叫她“师姐”
或“师妹”
、眼神各异的同门…
这些简单、甚至有些幼稚胡闹的经历，对于经历了无尽岁月、看惯生死背叛、肩负过寰宇重担的她而言，却显得格外珍贵和…温暖。
“好像…有点舍不得就这样结束呢。”

她嘴角微微勾起一丝真实的、不同于之前那种没心没肺的、带着些许感慨的笑意。
就在她心念转动间，关于这一世父母家族的记忆碎片也浮现出来——那个偏远小城的修真家族，父母资质平平，对她这个“天赋怪异”
（测灵石无反应）的女儿虽有关爱却更显疏离和无奈，家族资源倾斜给了更有前途的子弟…以及那个天生体弱、无法修炼、被父母寄予莫名厚望、需要无数资源温养的小妹…
云杳杳（真神·冥主·混沌掌控者版）的眼神瞬间冷了下来，闪过一丝了然与讥诮。
“原来…根源在这里。”
她低声冷笑，“是觉得我这一世的身体，或许也藏着类似‘神骨’‘灵根’的东西，想养好了…再取一次吗？”
虽然这一世的父母家族并未真正动手，甚至可能只是潜意识里的某种期望和算计，但结合第一世的背叛，足以让她心生寒意，彻底斩断那本就稀薄的亲情羁绊。
“青云宗…倒是个不错的避风港。”
她轻声道，心中已有了决断。
这一世，她只想守着这片小小的宗门，当她的“云师姐”
或者“云师妹”
，吃吃喝喝，玩玩闹闹，护一护这些让她觉得有趣的人。
只要…没人来找死。
content_en:
She saw...the first time she tried to use the power of chaos to reshape her body, but because it was the first time, there were some deficiencies, and the new body could not cultivate spiritual power.
But she relied on the power of chaos and the power of the underworld to still stir up trouble in that lower plane. In the chaos war that swept across the heavens, in order to protect the plane that accepted her, she sacrificed her life to activate the origin of chaos and build a protective barrier, and finally her soul returned to the underworld.
In that life, she was fully recognized by the origin of chaos.
She saw...returning to the underworld, using the Lord of the Underworld and the power of the origin of chaos to carefully reshape the divine body again and start the third life.
In this life, she originally just wanted to live an ordinary life, no longer shouldering the heavy responsibilities of the True God and the Lord of the Underworld, having sealed most of her power, and just wanted to experience a simple life... So, she chose the Qingyun Sect and became "Yun Yaoyao"
Memories flowed by like a flood, then slowly calmed down.
The vast and endless years, the unforgettable betrayal, the cruelty of the conquest of the underworld, the determination to protect the plane... they all finally settled down and merged into the body of the fifth level of Qi Refining at this moment, and into the depths of the soul that seemed to be unruly.
Yun Yaoyao...or in other words, after experiencing three reincarnations, as the only true god in the Nine Thousand God Realm, the supreme ruler of the underworld, and the controller of the origin of chaos, she slowly opened her eyes.
In those eyes, the clarity and agility of the past was still there, but they were deeper, as if they contained the endless starry sky and eternity. An indescribable indifference and majesty were naturally revealed, but she cleverly restrained them and hid them deep in her eyes.
She lowered her head and looked at her hands. The spiritual power at the fifth level of Qi Refining was pitifully meager.
She also sensed the silent terrifying power deep in the sea of ​​consciousness that could easily destroy the entire world of cultivation, as well as the self-sealed, gray energy of chaos and the death energy of the underworld deep in the Dantian.
As long as she is willing, with just one thought, she can unlock the seal and return to the supreme realm.
But she just sighed softly, with complicated eyes.
"That's it..."
She whispered to herself in a low voice, with an almost imperceptible hint of exhaustion and relief, "The first life was too tiring, the second life was too painful, this life... I wanted to be lazy."
She recalled every detail of her life in the Qingyun Sect: roasting earth-vein potatoes on the Wenxin steps, nibbling books and snacks in the library, Danfeng blindly refining the best elixirs, Qifeng custom-made mandarin duck pots, Fufeng scribbling the Qingfeng Talisman, Zhenfeng improving the fresh-locking formation... and those three little followers who were nervous but willing to protect her, the cheap master who looked serious but gave her great freedom, those who called her "senior sister"
or "junior sister"
, classmates with different eyes...
These simple and even childish experiences seemed particularly precious and...warm to her, who had gone through endless years, was used to witnessing betrayal in life and death, and had shouldered the heavy burdens of the world.
"It seems...I'm a little reluctant to end it like this."
The corner of her mouth slightly raised a real smile that was different from the heartless smile with a little emotion.
Just as her thoughts were turning, fragments of memories about her parents and family in this life also emerged - that cultivator family in a remote town, whose parents had mediocre qualifications and were unfavorable to her "weird talent."
Although the daughter of (The Spiritual Stone No Response) is caring, she is even more alienated and helpless. The family resources are given to the more promising children...and the little sister who is born weak, unable to practice, has inexplicable high hopes from her parents, and needs countless resources to nourish her...
Yun Yaoyao (True God, Lord of the Underworld, Controller of Chaos)'s eyes instantly turned cold, with a hint of understanding and ridicule flashing through his eyes.
"It turns out...the root is here."
She sneered in a low voice, "I think my body in this life may also contain something like a 'sacred bone' or a 'spiritual root'. Do you want to raise it... and take it out again?"
Although her parents and family did not actually take action in this life, and it might even be some subconscious expectation and calculation, but combined with the betrayal in the first life, it was enough to make her feel sad.The chill completely severed the already thin family ties.
"Qingyun Sect... is a good safe haven."
She said softly, already making a decision in her heart.
In this life, she just wants to guard this small sect and be her "Senior Sister Yun"
Or "Junior Sister Yun"
, eat, drink, play, and protect these people who make her interesting.
As long as...no one comes to die.
